messages:
maria.g: Heads up — vendor confirmed pen test window next Tue 10:00-14:00 PT. Need RBAC change for assessor roles + KMS read for logs. Who's owner?
ashok: I can own RBAC changes. scope: temp role or permanent?
jordan: Temp role with expiry + read-only to audit logs bucket. Also need presigned access to evidence bucket.
lia: We should use KMS decrypt via proxy; won't hand over master key. Assessor needs key-encrypt/decrypt on an ephemeral CMK only.
maria.g: Agreed. @ashok pls create role `pt_assessor_temp` with 6h TTL and tag `pt=acme`.
ashok: Will do. Quick Q: should we enable CloudTrail retention snapshot for the window?
jordan: Yes — frozen copy before window and export to presigned S3 with 7d TTL.
security-bot: Reminder: create Jira ticket SEC-PT-482 with evidence checklist. Template: `rbac, kms, logs, presigned_links, session_recordings`.
lia: Also add the log sampling bucket policy to allow vendor IP range during the window only.
nashok: Drafted IAM policy, will post snippet: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/ephemeral-key-id","arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/*"]}]}
```
maria.g: :thumbsup: Can you also wire up a CloudWatch metric to alert on any denied KMS requests during the window?
lia: Yes, I'll add a metric filter and a PagerDuty rule. PD escalation -> ops-oncall then sec-ic.
ops-oncall: Got it — I'll be available. Which runbook to follow on suspicious activity? https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pt-security
jordan: One more — for retest coordination vendor wants a 48h retest slot; recommend we block same weekday next week 10:00-12:00 as contingency.
maria.g: Locking tentative retest slot. @ashok once role created ping the vendor and add creds to the reading room.
ashok: Role created, TTL 6h, policy attached. Posted presigned link to Jira (SEC-PT-482). Credentials in reading room VM: `pt-readonly`.
security-bot: Audit: RBAC change recorded by infra-audit at 1775001245. Evidence snapshot created at 1775001300.
lia: Copied updated bucket policy to the evidence bucket; test export succeeded.
maria.g: Thanks team. We'll run a dry run tomorrow 09:30 — please join if you can.
ops-oncall: I'll join and mark calendar.
